root_cause.text: The memset() operation on the command slot header (`npu_slot`) was executed before validating that the remaining slot space (`*size`) is large enough to hold the header, leading to an out-of-bounds write when the slot is too small.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that "Clearing the command header with memset() before verifying the available slot space can result in an out-of-bounds write and memory corruption." The patch moves the memset() call after the size validation in all four affected functions: `aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_cf`, `aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_dpu`, `aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_preempt`, and `aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_elf`.
